title: rosa davurica var. alpestris
intro: Rosa davurica var. alpestris, commonly known as the Korean alpine rose, is a species of rose native to the mountainous regions of Korea. It is a perennial shrub with fragrant flowers and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The plant is said to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help in treating conditions such as fever, sore throat, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Rosa davurica var. alpestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
